SCORING_NOTE: per-slot accuracy beyond slot0 is NOT meaningful: slots>0 ask foreign questions about this state, whose gold answers are unknowable; slot0 (own question on own state) is the only gold-scored comparison. All slots are valid for agreement/drift.
note: encoder is BIDIRECTIONAL (is_causal=False): every question attends to all others in the request, so no slot is structurally immune; slot0 comparison is solo vs its position in the co-asked request. Batching invariance (same requests, different batch) is verified separately and holds to <1e-6.
